title: Upstream metadata lock
description: spec/upstream/bedrock-samples.lock.json. Pins the Mojang metadata snapshot the build generates from. NO CONTENT IS VENDORED — constitution rule 10. This file records hashes so the fetch is reproducible and tamper-evident.

license.description: Upstream licence as declared. NOASSERTION for bedrock-samples, which is why nothing may be redistributed.

ref.description: Branch or tag the commit was taken from, for humans.

commit.description: Exact commit SHA. The build fetches this, never a moving ref.

targetEngineVersion.description: The Bedrock engine version this snapshot represents, in creator-facing form (1.26.x, not 26.x). Used by SC-100 section 6 for min_engine_version gating.

publicVersion.description: The marketing version, for diagnostics that users will recognise.

files.description: Every file the build reads, with its hash. A mismatch fails the build rather than silently generating from different data.

usedBy.description: What consumes it: a coverage shard's upstream source, a codegen target, or a test corpus.
